name: Archipelago Dredge
author: Alextric234
description: Dredge mod to connect to archipelago multiworlds
latest_release_description:
> [!IMPORTANT] > This release pairs with **apworld 0.7.0**. Generate new seeds with apworld 0.7.0 and play them on mod 3.0.0. > Seeds generated with apworld 0.6.0 should be finished on **mod 2.0.0**: abilities, pursuits and research work differently now, and an old seed won't line up with the new mod. ## Highlights - **Pursuits are checks.** Character questlines, their reward grids, shrines, shore caches and found-loot spots now send checks instead of handing out their rewards. - **Messages in a bottle are checks**, and you keep the message. - **An in-game tracker** in a new Archipelago tab of the journal. - **Traps**, which can replace a share of filler. - **Boat performance logic** replaces the old engine requirement. - **Research is free.** Research checks are an option, and Research Parts are gone from the pool. ## New locations A default base-game seed now has **366** locations, up from 319. | Group | 0.6.0 | 0.7.0 | | --- | ---: | ---: | | Dredge spots | 126 | 126 | | Encyclopedia | 151 | 151 | | Research | 25 | 25 | | Research unlocks | 17 | now events | | Pursuits | – | 31 | | World | – | 23 | | Messages in a bottle | – | 10 | | **Total** | **319** | **366** | - **Pursuits:** each character's questline, including the steps where characters hand out research books, Grotesque Fish, the relic hand-ins, and the pursuit reward grids. - **World:** the shrines, 13 shore caches, the Old Wreck, the Old Mayor's Camps, the Old Laboratory and the Stone Tablets. - **The Iron Rig** adds 4 pursuit checks: Rig Built, Science Lab Built, Generator Fuelled and the Factory. - **The Pale Reach** adds 6 pursuit checks (Under The Ice ×4, the Ice Shaper and the shrine), 9 captain's logs, and the Teleport Anchor dredge spot. Removed: shop checks and the unused relic and prototype locations. ## New items - **The Collector's abilities** (Haste, Manifest, Banish, Atrophy) now come from the multiworld. The vanilla unlocks are withheld. - **Quest items:** Bronze Belt Buckle, Dog Tags, Mortar Frame, Mortar Barrel, Family Crest, Stone Tablet 1–3, and Ice Axe ×4 (Pale Reach). - **Aurous Anchor** (Pale Reach). - **Aberration chance items:** Progressive Aberration Chance and Guaranteed Aberrations. Each one received raises your minimum aberration chance. Turn the effect off per save with `ap aberrations off` or from the mod menu. - **13 traps:** Damaging Event, Scary Event, Money Loss, Teleport, Panic, Hull Damage, Engine Damage, Nightfall, Rot, Slow, Lights Out, Cargo Scramble and Reverse Controls. A trap that arrives while you're fishing, harvesting, holding an item or in a menu waits until it can fire. Pending traps are saved. - **Research Parts are removed** from the pool. ## Options | Option | Change | | --- | --- | | `require_engines` | Removed, replaced by `require_boat_performance` | | `require_boat_performance` | New. Areas need enough engine speed and light that fits your hull (see below) | | `include_message_bottles` | New, on by default | | `include_research_checks` | New, on by default | | `progressive_aberration_chance_items` | New, 0–20 | | `guaranteed_aberrations_item` | New | | `trap_percentage` | New, 0–100, default 0 | | `enabled_traps` | New, all traps by default | | `start_inventory_from_pool` | Now supported. Starting Progressive Hulls are capped at the seed's hull count | **Boat performance thresholds** | Area | Speed | Light | | --- | ---: | ---: | | Gale Cliffs, Stellar Basin, Twisted Strand, Devil's Spine | 50 kn | 1800 lm | | Open Ocean, the Iron Rig | 50 kn | 2100 lm | | The Pale Reach | 60 kn | 2100 lm | Shop-bought copies of engines and lights count toward this. Lights become progression when the option is on. **Aberrations** need at least half (rounded up) of the Progressive Aberration Chance items, or Guaranteed Aberrations. If neither option is on, aberrations aren't gated. ## Gameplay changes in AP saves - Research costs nothing, and every research tab is open from the start. - Iron Rig buildings need no Ironhaven Crates. - Freebies that aren't part of a pursuit are skipped. Free bait and free explosives are not handed out. - **Grotesque Fish no longer needs an aberration.** Its early steps are done for you, you're given the handkerchief, and Blackstone Isle is marked on your map. A Place to Rest is offered from the start. - Losing the Builder or the package rolls that pursuit back so you can pick it up again, instead of failing it. Losing the Castaway sends that pursuit's check. - The Researcher's prototype components are held until you receive the Sampling Device, which is not given to you separately. - Fish received from the multiworld never rot. - Shops stock three of each crab pot you've received. - Fishing licenses are enforced for crab pots, Insta-Crab Bait and trawl nets. - Items that need DLC you don't own are skipped. Icebreaker parts that arrive after the Icebreaker is equipped are dropped. - **Saves are bound to their multiworld.** Only a bound save auto-connects, and AP rules stay in effect while offline. Checks are stored in the save and resent on connect if the server is missing any. ## In-game tracker The journal has a new **Archipelago** tab. It lists every location by region with its logic status. - Filters, including a **Hinted** filter. Hinted items are marked as progression, useful or trap. - A **Logic needs** line for each location that says what's still missing. - **Map pins** for dredge spots, shrines, caches, bottles, pursuit characters and docks, shown as AP map stamps. - Shopkeepers' gift checks show how much more you need to buy or sell with them. - Links into the encyclopedia. - AP icons on trinket spots in the spyglass view. - The tracker logic is ported from the apworld and checked against it. ## Terminal commands | Command | What it does | | --- | --- | | `ap hint [item]` | Hints an item, or lists your hints with no name | | `ap hint_location ` | Hints what's at a location | | `ap say ` | Sends a chat message to the multiworld | | `ap ready` | Sends ready status to the server | | `ap received [filter]` | Lists items you've received | | `ap items [filter]` | Lists DREDGE item names, for hints | | `ap locations [filter]` | Lists locations you haven't checked yet | | `ap tracker [filter]` | Lists unchecked locations that are in logic | | `ap aberrations [on\|off]` | Shows or switches the boosted aberration chance from your items | | `ap !` | Runs any server command, e.g. `ap !missing` or `ap !remaining` | ## Fixes
Connection - Dropped or server-closed connections are detected, and a connect in progress can be cancelled. - Login failures show the reason. `ap connect` stops on an invalid port. - Slot-data flags parse as int, bool or string instead of failing the connect. - Unknown item names are skipped with a message instead of halting the item queue. - The DeathLink echo loop is fixed. DeathLink is only sent when it's enabled and you're connected. - AP state loads only for the slot being played, not every slot previewed. - Shops and aberration chance behave normally when not connected.
Gameplay - Loading a save no longer briefly counts as Open Ocean and triggers the passage block. - The Greater Marrow shipwright and the dry dock destinations unlock on connect. - Without the Iron Rig, the third Progressive Hull grants the tier-4 slot upgrades. - Hull tier and received items revert to the last game save when AP state loads. - Only caught fish count as fish checks, not every harvested item. - Hint and server `/send` messages no longer show item pop-ups. Pop-ups use the receiver's alias. - The Pale Reach passage and license are only required when the seed includes that DLC.
Logic (apworld) - Rods and nets only count once the hull has room to equip them. - Colossal Squid and Pale Grasper need the Radiant Trawl Net. - Oarfish and Gulper Eel don't need exotic bait, and other exotic fish have alternative requirements. - Iron Rig phase fish need Iron Rig access. - The three Icebreaker parts satisfy Icebreaker requirements. - The Deluxe-only Arterial Engine is removed from the pool. - Useful items are only added for expansions the seed includes. - Generation fails clearly when items outnumber locations.

name: Malignant Splashes
author: AudaciousBovine
description: Dark Splashes are more of a hazard now!
latest_release_description:
# Malignant Splashes
### Dark Splashes are more of a hazard now!
:green_square:
:purple_square:
:red_square:

## Updates
- :green_square:Added Config Menu
- :green_square:Cleaned up some code
- :purple_square:Made shipyards charge for removal (negative sale)
- :red_square:Removed Morrow Shipyard buying Materials (Splashes are now equipment so she "buys" them anyway)

## Features
- :red_square:Dark Splashes can no longer be discarded
- :red_square:Dark Splashes take an hour to move on your hull (Configurable)
- :red_square:Have to be properly cleaned and removed at a shipyard (Sell for negative value) (Configurable)
- :purple_square:Dark Splashes can be stuffed in your storage at a dock to clog its space while you find a shipyard
- :green_square:There may be a shop that actually pays you for them

## Would Like To Add
- :red_square:Extra panic rate per carried splash
- :purple_square:Some sort of proximity effect to fish on the hull
